searchText: Maybe I'm misunderstanding this, but going to a couple parties and asking them to improve their infra doesn't sound great for a robust decentralised protocol design. I'd rather keep slack in the protocol and make sure it works even if some parties misbehave, or have problems with their infra. The article (https://ethresear.ch/t/is-the-slot-0-reorg-cost-fixable-epbs-attestation-deadline-study/25338) merely tries to asses what's the effect of setting the attestation deadline to a particular time. In there, we study specially the slot-0 reorg rate. Which is the most affected slot by this particular effect. So, indeed we could do this (as I said to Potuz) and just be fine. It would make the slot-0 reorgs cause reduced throughput. But besides that, all fine. I'd say the protocol is solid anyways. They're the main parties affected anyways. It's mainly how aggressive we want to be (similar to EL changing gas costs and how bad the protocols get hit by it)
